hero.description: Le Cercle brings together services created for memorable events, each with its own atmosphere, aesthetic, and energy. Choose the experience that suits your moment.

bureau.tagline: Cigar lounge with retro and classic flair.

maison.tagline: French dessert served as a live moment.

perle.tagline: Piaggio Ape with Italian gelato and refreshing cocktails.

step1.title: When is your event?
step1.subtitle: Choose a date and number of guests for your event.

step2.title: What services do you need?
step2.subtitle: You can select one or more services for your event.

step3.title: Choose packages
step3.subtitle: Select a package for each chosen service.

step4.title: Event location
step4.subtitle: Fill in the details about where your event will take place.
step4.notes_placeholder: Any details relevant to our team...
step4.transport_free_body: In Chișinău, transport and logistics are not charged separately. Our team comes to your venue at no extra travel cost.
step4.transport_fee_body: The travel and logistics cost for our team is calculated automatically and added to the total booking amount.

step5.title: Contact details
step5.subtitle: We'll use these details to confirm your booking.
step5.send_error: Could not send the code. Check the details and try again.

step6.title: Summary & payment
step6.subtitle: Your number has been confirmed. Review the details and confirm your booking.
step6.payment_title: HOW WOULD YOU LIKE TO PAY?
step6.payment_subtitle: The 10% advance locks your date and confirms the booking. The remaining 90% is paid on the day of the event.
step6.pay_now_sub: Pay {amount} now and your booking is confirmed immediately, with the date locked in our calendar.
step6.pay_later_sub: The {amount} advance can be paid later online or arranged in a meeting with our team.
step6.submit_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

step7.title: Booking pending
step7.subtitle: Your request has been received. Pay the advance of {amount} to confirm your booking.

steps.label: Request received
steps.sub: We've received all the details of your event.

steps.label: Pay advance of {amount}
steps.sub: Pay online from your profile or contact us to arrange an alternative payment method.

steps.label: Contract in your profile
steps.sub: Once the advance is paid, the contract is automatically generated and available in your profile for viewing and download.

steps.label: Coordination call
steps.sub: A coordinator will contact you within 2–3 business days to discuss technical details and event preferences.

payment_success.title: Booking confirmed
payment_success.subtitle: Your event is firmly booked. We'll be in touch soon to discuss the details.

steps.label: Advance paid

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Enter your phone number. We'll send you an SMS with a 6-digit code to confirm the number belongs to you.
